title: 學華語向前走 2A — Lesson 5
description: Vocabulary from lesson 5 of the textbook 學華語向前走 (Let's Learn Mandarin) 2A, with original example sentences written for young beginners (Traditional characters).

exampleSentences.pinyin: xiànzài shì qiūtiān.
exampleSentences.english: It is autumn now.

exampleSentences.pinyin: qiūtiān de shùyè shì huángsè de.
exampleSentences.english: In autumn, the leaves are yellow.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 秋天的早上很涼，我要穿外套上學。
exampleSentences.pinyin: qiūtiān de zǎoshang hěn liáng, wǒ yào chuān wàitào shàngxué.
exampleSentences.english: On autumn mornings it is cold, so I wear a jacket to school.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 秋天，媽媽煮了熱湯給我們喝。
exampleSentences.pinyin: qiūtiān, māma zhǔ le rè tāng gěi wǒmen hē.
exampleSentences.english: In autumn, Mum makes hot soup for us to drink.

exampleSentences.pinyin: zhè shì yí piàn shùyè.
exampleSentences.english: This is a leaf.

exampleSentences.pinyin: shùyè zài dìshang.
exampleSentences.english: The leaves are on the ground.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我在公園撿到一片很大的樹葉，送給媽媽。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ zài gōngyuán jiǎndào yí piàn hěn dà de shùyè, sòng gěi māma.
exampleSentences.english: I found a very big leaf in the park and gave it to Mum.

exampleSentences.pinyin: shùyè luò zài wǒ de shūbāo shàng.
exampleSentences.english: A leaf fell onto my school bag.

exampleSentences.pinyin: tiānqì biàn lěng le.
exampleSentences.english: The weather has turned cold.

exampleSentences.pinyin: yèzi biàn huáng le.
exampleSentences.english: The leaves have turned yellow.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我的足球鞋變髒了，要洗乾淨。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ de zúqiúxié biàn zāng le, yào xǐ gānjìng.
exampleSentences.english: My soccer boots got dirty, so I have to wash them clean.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 看！我的積木變成了一座城堡。
exampleSentences.pinyin: kàn! wǒ de jīmù biàn chéng le yí zuò chéngbǎo.
exampleSentences.english: Look! My blocks have turned into a castle.

exampleSentences.pinyin: xiāngjiāo shì huáng de.
exampleSentences.english: Bananas are yellow.

exampleSentences.pinyin: nǐ de shūbāo shì huáng de ma?
exampleSentences.english: Is your school bag yellow?

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我在黃色的校車上睡著了。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ zài huángsè de xiàochē shàng shuìzháo le.
exampleSentences.english: I fell asleep on the yellow school bus.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 下雨天，我穿黃色的雨衣踩水坑。
exampleSentences.pinyin: xiàyǔtiān, wǒ chuān huángsè de yǔyī cǎi shuǐkēng.
exampleSentences.english: On a rainy day I wear my yellow raincoat and stomp in puddles.

exampleSentences.pinyin: cǎo shì lǜsè de.
exampleSentences.english: Grass is green.

exampleSentences.pinyin: zhèlǐ yǒu hěn duō cǎo.
exampleSentences.english: There is a lot of grass here.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我們在草地上玩捉迷藏。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒmen zài cǎodì shàng wán zhuōmícáng.
exampleSentences.english: We play hide-and-seek on the grass.

exampleSentences.pinyin: xiǎogǒu zài cǎo shàng pǎo lái pǎo qù.
exampleSentences.english: The puppy runs back and forth on the grass.

exampleSentences.pinyin: nǐ xǐhuan lǜsè ma?
exampleSentences.english: Do you like green?

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ de shuǐbēi shì lǜsè de.
exampleSentences.english: My water bottle is green.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我們的足球隊穿綠色的球衣。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒmen de zúqiúduì chuān lǜsè de qiúyī.
exampleSentences.english: Our soccer team wears green jerseys.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 公園的湖邊有一隻綠色的青蛙。
exampleSentences.pinyin: gōngyuán de húbiān yǒu yì zhī lǜsè de qīngwā.
exampleSentences.english: There is a green frog by the lake in the park.

exampleSentences.pinyin: jīntiān de tiānqì hěn hǎo.
exampleSentences.english: The weather is nice today.

exampleSentences.pinyin: nǐ xǐhuan shénme yàng de tiānqì?
exampleSentences.english: What kind of weather do you like?

exampleSentences.hanzi: 天氣很熱，我們去海灘玩水。
exampleSentences.pinyin: tiānqì hěn rè, wǒmen qù hǎitān wán shuǐ.
exampleSentences.english: It is very hot, so we go to the beach to play in the water.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 爸爸看天氣預報，說明天會下雨。
exampleSentences.pinyin: bàba kàn tiānqì yùbào, shuō míngtiān huì xiàyǔ.
exampleSentences.english: Dad checks the weather forecast and says it will rain tomorrow.

exampleSentences.pinyin: zhè zhāng yǐzi hěn shūfu.
exampleSentences.english: This chair is very comfortable.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ dùzi bù shūfu.
exampleSentences.english: My tummy doesn't feel good.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 媽媽幫我蓋好被子，我睡得很舒服。
exampleSentences.pinyin: māma bāng wǒ gàihǎo bèizi, wǒ shuì de hěn shūfu.
exampleSentences.english: Mum tucks my blanket in, and I sleep very comfortably.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 跑完步，我坐在沙發上休息，很舒服。
exampleSentences.pinyin: pǎo wán bù, wǒ zuò zài shāfā shàng xiūxi, hěn shūfu.
exampleSentences.english: After a run, I rest on the sofa, and it feels really nice.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 在澳洲，春天是九月到十一月。
exampleSentences.pinyin: zài Àozhōu, chūntiān shì jiǔyuè dào shíyīyuè.
exampleSentences.english: In Australia, spring is from September to November.

exampleSentences.pinyin: chūntiān, huā kāi le.
exampleSentences.english: In spring, the flowers have bloomed.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 春天的下午，我和爸爸去公園放風箏。
exampleSentences.pinyin: chūntiān de xiàwǔ, wǒ hé bàba qù gōngyuán fàng fēngzheng.
exampleSentences.english: On spring afternoons, Dad and I fly kites in the park.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 春天到了，窗外有很多小鳥在唱歌。
exampleSentences.pinyin: chūntiān dào le, chuāng wài yǒu hěn duō xiǎoniǎo zài chànggē.
exampleSentences.english: Spring has arrived, and lots of little birds are singing outside the window.

exampleSentences.pinyin: zhè zhāng huà búcuò.
exampleSentences.english: This drawing is pretty good.

exampleSentences.pinyin: nǐ de zì xiě de búcuò.
exampleSentences.english: Your handwriting is pretty good.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 媽媽說我做的餅乾味道不錯。
exampleSentences.pinyin: māma shuō wǒ zuò de bǐnggān wèidao búcuò.
exampleSentences.english: Mum said the biscuits I made taste pretty good.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 這場足球賽我踢得不錯。
exampleSentences.pinyin: zhè chǎng zúqiúsài wǒ tī de búcuò.
exampleSentences.english: I played pretty well in this soccer match.

exampleSentences.pinyin: nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?
exampleSentences.english: What colour do you like?

exampleSentences.hanzi: 今天我們學習不同的顏色。
exampleSentences.pinyin: jīntiān wǒmen xuéxí bùtóng de yánsè.
exampleSentences.english: Today we are learning different colours.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我的蠟筆有十二種顏色。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ de làbǐ yǒu shí'èr zhǒng yánsè.
exampleSentences.english: My crayon box has twelve colours.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 媽媽讓我挑一個喜歡的顏色。
exampleSentences.pinyin: māma ràng wǒ tiāo yí ge xǐhuan de yánsè.
exampleSentences.english: Mum lets me pick a colour I like.

exampleSentences.pinyin: nǐ shénme shíhou chī wǔfàn?
exampleSentences.english: When do you eat lunch?

exampleSentences.pinyin: shàngkè de shíhou yào zuòhǎo.
exampleSentences.english: Sit up properly when you are in class.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我踢足球的時候，爸爸在旁邊看。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ tī zúqiú de shíhou, bàba zài pángbiān kàn.
exampleSentences.english: When I play soccer, Dad watches from the side.

exampleSentences.pinyin: bàba shénme shíhou lái jiē wǒ?
exampleSentences.english: When is Dad coming to pick me up?

exampleSentences.pinyin: zhè shì yì duǒ huā.
exampleSentences.english: This is a flower.

exampleSentences.pinyin: huāyuán lǐ yǒu hěn duō huā.
exampleSentences.english: There are lots of flowers in the garden.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ sòng māma yí shù huā.
exampleSentences.english: I give Mum a bunch of flowers.

exampleSentences.pinyin: māma zài jiāménkǒu jiāo huā.
exampleSentences.english: Mum waters the flowers by the front door.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ jiā yǒu yí ge yuànzi.
exampleSentences.english: We have a yard at home.

exampleSentences.pinyin: yuànzi lǐ yǒu yì kē dà shù.
exampleSentences.english: There is a big tree in the yard.

exampleSentences.pinyin: bàba zài yuànzi lǐ kǎo ròu.
exampleSentences.english: Dad is barbecuing in the yard.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我的球滾進了鄰居的院子裡。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ de qiú gǔn jìn le línjū de yuànzi lǐ.
exampleSentences.english: My ball rolled into the neighbour's yard.

exampleSentences.pinyin: zhè shì hóngsè de qìqiú.
exampleSentences.english: This is a red balloon.

exampleSentences.pinyin: cǎoméi shì hóngsè de.
exampleSentences.english: Strawberries are red.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我戴了一頂紅色的帽子去踢球。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ dài le yì dǐng hóngsè de màozi qù tī qiú.
exampleSentences.english: I wore a red hat to go and play soccer.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我的書包裡有一枝紅色的筆。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ de shūbāo lǐ yǒu yì zhī hóngsè de bǐ.
exampleSentences.english: There is a red pen in my school bag.

exampleSentences.pinyin: tiānshàng de yún shì báisè de.
exampleSentences.english: The clouds in the sky are white.

exampleSentences.pinyin: qǐng ná yì zhāng báisè de zhǐ.
exampleSentences.english: Please take one sheet of white paper.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我抱著一隻白色的小貓。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ bào zhe yì zhī báisè de xiǎomāo.
exampleSentences.english: I am holding a white kitten.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 海灘上有很多白色的貝殼。
exampleSentences.pinyin: hǎitān shàng yǒu hěn duō báisè de bèiké.
exampleSentences.english: There are lots of white shells on the beach.

exampleSentences.pinyin: nǐ de xīn qúnzi hěn piàoliàng.
exampleSentences.english: Your new dress is very pretty.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 老師今天穿了一件漂亮的衣服。
exampleSentences.pinyin: lǎoshī jīntiān chuān le yí jiàn piàoliàng de yīfu.
exampleSentences.english: The teacher is wearing a pretty outfit today.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ de shēngrì dàngāo hǎo piàoliàng!
exampleSentences.english: My birthday cake is so pretty!

exampleSentences.hanzi: 公園的鸚鵡飛來飛去，很漂亮。
exampleSentences.pinyin: gōngyuán de yīngwǔ fēi lái fēi qù, hěn piàoliàng.
exampleSentences.english: The parrots flying around the park are very pretty.
